description: Japanese input helper for Windows that types Japanese and English without toggling the input mode
post_install: if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ime) { . $ime; if (-not (Install-MeltypeIme -Source (Join-Path $dir 'app\tip'))) { Write-Host 'Meltype IME is not registered, so Meltype runs with the conversion box. Run C:\Program Files\Meltype\tip\Register-Tip.ps1 as administrator, or reinstall, to register it.' } }
pre_uninstall: Get-Process Meltype, meltype_mozc_helper, AutoIME -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($isUpdate) { Write-Host 'Updating Meltype: keeping the IME registration and the user data.'; return }

if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ime) { . $ime; if (-not (Uninstall-MeltypeIme)) { Write-Host 'Meltype IME is still registered. Run C:\Program Files\Meltype\tip\Register-Tip.ps1 -Unregister as administrator.' } }

foreach ($name in 'Meltype', 'AutoIME') { $data = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA $name; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $data) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $data -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }
$separate = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Meltype'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $separate) { Write-Host "A Meltype copy installed outside Scoop is left in place: $separate" }
notes: Installing registers Meltype as a Windows IME, which asks for administrator rights (UAC). Declining keeps the conversion-box input mode; the registration script can be run again later.
The bundled update script is removed on install, so Meltype cannot install itself outside Scoop: use 'scoop update meltype' and quit Meltype before updating.
Settings, learning data and logs live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Meltype, outside the Scoop directory. 'scoop uninstall meltype' removes them together with the IME registration.
'Windows の起動時に起動' registers the path Meltype was started from. Start Meltype through the shim or a shortcut to scoop\shims\meltype.exe so autostart survives updates.
